title: CytoCV: Reproducible Yeast Microscopy Analysis
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Open-source Django platform that uses DIC-guided Mask R-CNN segmentation to turn DeltaVision and TIFF yeast microscopy stacks into reviewable per-cell fluorescence measurements and structured exports.
profile_labs: SEE Lab, UW Bothell School of STEM|Miller Lab, University of Utah
detail_summary: Architected microscopy ingestion, DIC-guided Mask R-CNN inference, worker-backed analysis, PostgreSQL persistence, and production Linux delivery.
impact: Released CytoCV v2.0.0 as a citable open-source software artifact with a versioned DOI.
bullets: Translated biology-facing requirements into channel-aware DeltaVision and TIFF ingestion|Engineered cell and cell-pair segmentation with reviewable multichannel overlays|Built configurable puncta distance, biorientation, contour intensity, and nuclear analysis workflows|Designed background jobs, progress and cancellation flows, protected artifacts, and durable result storage|Led production deployment, regression testing, documentation, and ongoing maintenance
graphical_abstract_alt: Four-step CytoCV workflow from yeast microscopy channels through segmentation and fluorescence measurement to reviewable CSV/XLSX export.

title: Adversarial Machine Learning
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Independent study that prototyped four adversarial attack families and four defensive strategies with ART and TensorFlow/Keras across standard image-classification benchmarks.
detail_summary: Integrated ART primitives with TensorFlow/Keras models to test evasion, extraction, inversion, poisoning, detection, preprocessing, postprocessing, and distillation workflows.
impact: Built eight focused attack-and-defense prototypes across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10.
bullets: Generated DeepFool adversarial examples and built Copycat CNN extraction experiments|Built MIFace model-inversion and corner-trigger backdoor-poisoning experiments|Trained an adversarial-input detector on FGM samples and evaluated JPEG preprocessing|Compared Gaussian-noise postprocessing and defensive distillation|Measured attack success and clean, attacked, and defended model accuracy
graphical_abstract_alt: Four-step adversarial machine-learning study showing image-classification data and models, attack experiments, defense experiments, and evaluation outputs.

title: Guide Donor Scheduler: Yeast CRISPR Sequence Design
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Python pipeline that converts yeast FASTA sequences and requested amino-acid substitutions into CRISPR/Cas9 guide and donor constructs with strand-aware PAM handling and researcher-ready XLS output.
detail_summary: Built a configurable Python CLI with FASTA ingestion, strand-aware PAM discovery, codon-aware mutation rules, ranked candidate selection, and XLS generation.
impact: Automated guide and donor design from sequence input to traceable, order-ready results.
bullets: Located forward NGG and reverse-strand CCN PAM sites across FASTA records|Encoded amino-acid substitutions with codon-aware silent PAM and seed edits|Supported guide filtering, ranking, duplicate removal, validation, kill guides, and reverse complements|Generated color-coded XLS workbooks with guides, PAMs, mutation offsets, cut-site distances, and decision rationale|Tested inversion, PAM discovery, mutation generation, disruption, and adjacent mutations in GitHub Actions
graphical_abstract_alt: Four-step GuideDonorScheduler workflow from FASTA input through guide selection and donor design to annotated XLS output.
